tasks.instructions: Repair the active arena-camera defect at the camera/integration root rather than repeating blind transform tuning. In scripts/camera/arena_camera.gd and its directly bound scene/config, preserve the high-angle contract, add camera-aware sight lanes or selective bounded transparency, and correct collision-layer/mask interaction so MausoleumCollision cannot fully occlude the central route or landmark while threats remain visible. In the real upgrade-draft scene/controller, implement a choice visual hierarchy: lead every choice with authored silhouettes or icons, show compact stat icons and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, omit unchanged/exhaustive rows and NEW/LOCKED CURRENT placeholders, keep copy restrained, and provide complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states. Preserve existing weapon and map assets.
